# UNDERSONG for three (NP=3): two friends who never miss (DUO=0) and every note of yours caught (CATCH=1). The same
# presses as duo.txt: the menu, the story's first chapter (its story page, how it is played, both ready, the count),
# POTION CHOIR to its end and its result; then TWIN ROAD, ECHO STEPS and NOTE RALLY the same way, the finale, the menu
# of the four games with their scores, and ROCK-OFF chosen there and played. PLAY is pressed all the way, except over a
# result.
